description: List the app windows with their id, index, title, url, and visibility. Pass sessionId to target a specific session. Returns: { ok, session_id, windows, active_window_id, count }. Errors: NOT_RUNNING (no such session; not retryable), BAD_ARGUMENT (multiple sessions — pass sessionId).

sessionId.description: Target session id. Omit when a single session is running.

name: electron_windows_list
title: List Electron windows
